name: Penelope Ann Miller
bio:
Penelope Ann Miller (born Penelope Andrea Miller; January 13, 1964), is an American actress. She began her career on Broadway, and starred in several major Hollywood films, particularly in the early 1990s, and has continued appearing in supporting roles in both film and television.
